test_title: PYST 11: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3000 as a sum borrowed at 9% per year rate of interest for 6 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3000

Rate of Interest (r) = 9% per year

Time (t) = 6 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times r times t}{100} 

**Calculation:**

SI = dfrac{3000 times 9 times 6}{100} 

⇒ SI = dfrac{162000}{100} 

⇒ SI = ₹1620

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
